title: Conifer trees can prosper half a world away from their usual home
title_zh: 针叶树在远离其常驻地半个地球的地方也能繁茂
abstract: Northern Hemisphere trees planted in the Southern Hemisphere can thrive, displaying increased stem growth and physiological signals linked to reduced stress.
abstract_zh: 在南半球种植的北半球针叶树能够茁壮成长，表现出更高的干茎生长和与减轻压力相关的生理信号提升。
snippet: Northern Hemisphere trees planted in the Southern Hemisphere can thrive, displaying increased stem growth and physiological signals linked to reduced stress.
